real_qa.q: What is the IBCM-CoGRIT framework and how does it redefine corporate governance for the AI era?
real_qa.r: IBCM-CoGRIT addresses the governance gap by establishing the missing conceptual architecture for 21st century organizational accountability. real_qa.q: What does privatization of gain and socialization of risk mean in the context of AI and tech companies?
real_qa.r: Tech companies capture instant profitability on their balance sheets by deploying unvetted AI systems, but they externalize all the long-term societal costs onto the public. Engineers and economists building the tech reap immediate rewards of optimization and growth, but when their predictive models inevitably break down, it is the public who inherits the massive risk of systemic failure.

real_qa.q: Why did the Long-Term Capital Management hedge fund collapse in 1998 and what warning does it provide for modern AI trading?

The simulation failed and nearly took down the entire global financial system.
